tasks.label: Initialize repository and connect GitHub
tasks.command: git init -b main; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { git remote add origin https://github.com/pouyanRG/Restaurant-Menu.git }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { git remote -v; git ls-remote --heads origin }

tasks.label: Commit and push to GitHub
tasks.command: git add -A; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git status --short; git commit -m "Initial project commit" -m "Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git push -u origin main; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git status --short --branch
